android-data-display|Carousel.summary: A Plenix carousel on Android is Material 3’s carousel, kept native in behavior (the fling and snap, the keyline layout that shrinks the items at the edge, TalkBack’s scroll actions, font scale) and drawn with the Plenix roles: each slide keeps its own Plenix shape (a media card’s 12 dp corners) instead of Material’s large mask, the items are 12 dp apart, and the page dots under it use the iOS page control’s roles, the current page in the default content color and the others in the strong border color, each on a 48 dp target. It never advances by itself unless the app turns autoplay on, and then a Pause button comes first. Material’s default masks every item with its extra-large corner and has no page dots; Plenix keeps Material’s carousel and replaces the look.
